fursona.description: An old green dragon, scales dulled to the color of moss, curled up so that he takes up far more of the room than strictly necessary. A pair of half-moon reading glasses perch on his snout, and a worn paperback is balanced on one claw. Wisps of smoke curl from his nostrils whenever he sighs, which is often.
